Nodes searched by alpha-beta with perfect move ordering, b^(d/2):
Three ply is affordable. Five is not - and each node needs a full game-state simulation, not just an evaluation.
Chess versus Generals.io. Sound pruning gets us to three ply and no further; depth beyond that needs forward pruning.
